integrity: Analytic containment, two John moment identities, uniqueness, spectral determinant and cycle-limit arguments are given. Published mathematical methods are cited. Independent mathematical audit and priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires a finite connected simple graph with degree at least two and automorphisms transitive on both vertices and edges. Concerns fractional matching polytopes, not integral matching polytopes. The general spectral root may not be solvable by radicals. Finite computations corroborate only the checked cases.
title: Spectral John ellipsoids of vertex-and-edge-transitive fractional matching polytopes
